name: hig
description: Apple's Human Interface Guidelines inside Claude Code: Claude works with them in mind, each edit is checked against them, and an audit pane shows which guidelines your app covers and which it does not yet.

guide.title: HIG: guide Claude
guide.description: on: in an app project, Claude's system prompt carries the guidelines that apply to it. off: Claude is not told.

editCheck.title: HIG: check each edit
editCheck.description: on: after Claude writes or edits a UI file, the guidelines that edit breaks reach Claude with the lines and links. off: only the audit pane.
